total_funding_usd.quote: Prior to the acquisition, Paperspace raised $35 million from investors including Battery Ventures, Intel Capital, SineWave Ventures and Sorenson Capital.

last_round.quote: DigitalOcean ... today announced that it's acquiring Paperspace, a New York-based cloud computing and AI development startup, for $111 million in cash.

note: Paperspace was co-founded in 2014 by Daniel Kobran and Dillon Erb (YC W15, backed by Y Combinator and DigitalOcean co-founder Jeff Carr). Acquired by DigitalOcean for $111M cash in July 2023; operated as a standalone business unit initially, and the Paperspace brand was folded into DigitalOcean in 2024 (per DigitalOcean's own 'Paperspace joins DigitalOcean' page). The YC page for 'Paperspace' (W15) is confirmed to be this same GPU-cloud company, not a different company.
